description:
As a customer, I want to filter the products.

* Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

criteria.text: Filters should narrow down the list correctly.

cases.title: Applying a single filter narrows the product list to matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows an unfiltered list containing products that match a given filter value and products that do not.
steps: Note the products shown in the unfiltered list.
Apply one filter with a value that at least one product matches.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed: only products matching the applied filter value are shown, and products that do not match are no longer listed.

cases.title: Applying more than one filter narrows the list further
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and shows an unfiltered list containing at least one product that matches two different filter values and products that match only one of them.
steps: Apply a first filter with a value that several products match and note the resulting list.
Apply a second filter with a value that only some of those products match.
cases.expected: The list is narrowed further: only products matching the applied filters remain; products not matching are not listed. (The exact way multiple filters are combined is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Filter value with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and a filter value exists that no product in the catalogue matches.
steps: Apply the filter using the value that no product matches.
cases.expected: No products are shown, since no product matches the filter; no non-matching products are listed. (The exact empty-result message or display is not specified in the story.)

cases.title: Removing an applied filter stops narrowing the list by that filter
cases.preconditions: The product list page is open and one filter is already applied, so the list is narrowed.
steps: Note the products shown while the filter is applied.
cases.expected: The list is no longer narrowed by that filter: products that were hidden by it are shown again. (The exact behaviour of removing a filter is not specified in the story.)
